THE LAND ACQUISITION ACT (CHAPTER 460)
Notice under Section 7
My Ref. No.: RBK/LAN/AQURE/A3/112.Ministry of Land Reference No.: 4-3/7/2018/HW/433.

I hereby give notice, under Sub-section (1) of Section 7 of theLand Acquisition Act, No. 28 of 1964, that the Governmentintends to acquire the following land/ servitude* which isrequired for a public purpose:
